verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference/training infrastructure platform (model hosting, fine-tuning, dedicated endpoints) rather than a data application that ingests a user's business data and surfaces AI-generated insights/suggestions within its own UI. The evidence describes APIs, agent tool-calling, and fine-tuning capabilities developers can build with, not an in-product insights feature over the user's own data — this axis is a category mismatch for an inference platform.
